notes.title: Military Logistics Simulator Demo Update 2
notes.content: [p][b]Attention![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Military Logistics Simulator during Next Fest. The festival is over, but we have decided to leave the demo running for a little while longer. We have also uploaded one more update to include some of your feedback. [/p][p]Among a bunch of smaller fixes, the changes include modified mission dialogue and new encubrance mechanics. Also, settings menus will scale better to different types of monitors. Have fun with the demo, wishlist the game to receive news and updates, and let us know what you think about the changes. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Stay vigilant![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Nano Games Team[/p]
